description: This file defines a base interface 'Node' for all predicate nodes within an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) in a Java-based RQL (Resource Query Language) predicate system. It includes a method for the visitor pattern used for traversing or processing AST nodes.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Base interface for all predicate nodes in an AST, providing the 'accept' method for visitor pattern traversal.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor, allowing the visitor to process or traverse this node.
